sources.title: JustOnion/Mag-Mell-R1-Uncensored-21B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Mag-Mell-R1-Uncensored-21B The original Mag-Mell-R1 12B by inflatebot is a fantastic model. Few have even come close. For a long time my goto has been Frowning's 21B Passthrough of Mag-Mell-R1. It's a little smarter than the original 12B, the larger size makes less mistakes in story details and grammar.
